उ: उ The third short vowel of the Sanskrit alphabet, corresponding to the letter U, and pronounced as that is in the word full.
उ r. 1st cl. (ङ) उङ् (उवते) To sound, to make a particular sound or noise.
उ ind. An interjection, 1. of assent; 2. of calling; 3. of compas-sion; 4. anger; and 5. of command. 	 6. An expletive. 	 m. (-उः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. Of BRAHMA.
उकनाह: उकनाह m. (-हः) A horse of a red and yellow, or red and black colour, a bay or chesnut horse.
उकुण: उकुण m. (-णः) A bug. Also उत्कुण.
उक्त: उक्त n. (-क्तं) A sentence. 	 nf. (-क्तं-क्ता) A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant, one long or two short syllables in each. 	 mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Spoken, said.  E. वच् to speak, affix क्त and व changed to उ.
उक्तवत्: उक्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Said, was saying.  E. वच् to speak, क्तवतु affix of the past part.
उक्तवाक्य: उक्तवाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) One who has borne testimony or given an opinion. 	 n. (-क्यं) A dictum, a decree.  E. उक्त and वाक्य dictum.
उक्ति: उक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Speech, speaking.  E. वच् to speak, and क्तिन् aff.
उक्तोपसंहार: उक्तोपसंहार m. (-रः) Any brief or compendious phrase or description. E. उक्त what is said, उपसंहार compendiousness.
उक्त्वा: उक्त्वा ind. Having spoken or said.  E. वच् to speak, क्त्वाच् aff.
उक्थ: उक्थ n. (-क्थं) The second or Sama Veda. 	 f. (-क्था) A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines of one syllable each, the syllable may be one long or two short in quantity.  E. वच् to speak, and थक् Unadi affix.
उक्ष: उक्ष r. 1st. cl. (उक्षति) 	 1. To sprinkle or wet. 	 2. To clean.
उक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 	 1. Cleansed, washed. 	 2. Wet, moist.  E. उक्ष् to wet, affix अप्.
उक्षतर: उक्षतर m. (-रः) A large bull or ox.  E. उक्षन् an ox, and तरप् aff.
उक्षन्: उक्षन् m. (-क्षा) An ox or bull.  E. उक्ष् to sprinkle, and कनिन् Unādi aff.
उक्षाल: उक्षाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Swift. 	 2. Excellent. 	 3. Terrible. 	 4. High. 5. Much. 	 m. (-लः) A monkey.
उक्षित: उक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sprinkled. 	 2. Cleansed, perfumed.  E. उक्ष् to wet, and क्त aff.
उख: उख r. 1st cl. (ओखति) (इ) उखि (उंखति) 1. To go, to move or approach. 2. To dry, to wither. 	 3. To adorn. The first retains the diphthong with a prefix ending in अ, as प्र and ओखति make प्रोखति.
उखर्वल: उखर्व्वल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
उखर्व्वल: उखर्व्वल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
उखल: उखल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
उखा: उखा f. (-खा) A pot or saucepan, &c.  E. उख् to go, क affix, and टाप्, also उघा.
उख्य: उख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Boiled, dressed in a pot, (flesh, &c.)  E. उखा a pot and यत् aff.
उग्र: उग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 	 1. Angry, wrathful. 	 2. Hot, sharp, pungent, acrid. 	 3. Formidable, terrible. 	 4. Cruel, flerce, savage. 	 m. (-ग्रः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. A name of a mixed tribe, from a Kshetriya father and Sudra mother: the employment of this caste according to Menu, is the killing or catching of animals that live in holes, as a snake-catcher, &c.; according to the Tantras, the Ugra is an en-comiast or bard. 	 3. A tree, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.) 	 4. A class of asterisms, Magha Rharani, Purvaphalguni, Purvasharha, Purvabhadrapada. 	 5. A name of Malabar. 	 f. (-ग्रा) 	 1. Orris root. 	 2. A medicinal plant. 	 3. An Ugra woman. 	 n. (-ग्रं) Wrath, anger.  E. उच् to accumulate, रन् Unādi affix, च is changed to ग.
उग्रकर्मन्: उग्रकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Fierce, violent, cruel.  E. उग्र and कर्म्मन् act.
उग्रकर्म्मन्: उग्रकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Fierce, violent, cruel.  E. उग्र and कर्म्मन् act.
उग्रकाण्ड: उग्रकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A sort of gourd, (Momordica charantia.)  E. उग्र and काण्ड a stem.
उग्रगन्ध: उग्रगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Strong smelling. 	 m. (-न्धः) 	 1. A plant, (Michelia champaca.) 	 2. Garlic. 	 n. (-न्धं) Asafœtida. 	 f. (-न्धा) 	 1. Com-mon caraway, (Carum carui, &c.) see अजमोदा. 	 2. Orris root. 	 3. A medicinal plant.  E. उग्र violent, &c. and गन्ध scent.
उग्रगन्धिन्: उग्रगन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Strong smelling.  E. उग्रगन्ध and इनि aff.
उग्रचय: उग्रचय m. (-यः) Desire.  E. उग्र fierce, चय a heap.
उग्रत्व: उग्रत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Violence, passionateness. 	 2. Pungency acrimony.  E. उग्र angry, and त्व; also with तल् affix. उग्रता f. (-ता.)
उग्रदण्ड: उग्रदण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Relentless, remorseless.  E. उग्र and दण्ड punishment.
उग्रधन्वन्: उग्रधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A name of INDRA.  E. उग्र fierce, and धन्वन् a bowyer.
उग्रनासिक: उग्रनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Large-nosed.  E. उग्र formidable, and नासिका a nose.
उग्रम्पश्य: उग्रम्पश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 	 1. Frightful, hideous, fierce looking. 	 2. Malig-nant, wicked.  E. उग्र fierce, पश्य looking.
उग्रशेखरा: उग्रशेखरा f. (-रा) A name of GANGA.  E. उग्र SIVA, and शेखरा a crest.
उग्रसेन: उग्रसेन m. (-नः) 	 1. The name of a prince, the father of DEVAKI and KANSA, and king of Mathura. 	 2. The name of another prince, the son of PARIKSHIT.  E. उग्र fierce, and सेना an army.
उग्रसेनज: उग्रसेनज m. (-जः) A name of KANSA, the uncle and enemy of KRISHNA. E. उग्रसेन and ज born; also उग्रसेनतनयः, उग्रसेनपुत्रः, उग्रसेनसुतः, &c.
उङ्कुण: उङ्कुण m. (-णः) A bug: see उत्कुण.  E. उ fear, and कुण a sound.
उच: उच r. 4th cl. (उच्यति) To be conglomerate, to be gathered or assembled together, to unite or associate with.
उचित: उचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Proper, suitable, convenient. 	 2. Receivable, fit or right to be taken. 	 3. Known, understood. 	 4. Intrusted, deposited. 5. Measured, adjusted, accurate.  E. वच् to speak, and कितच् Unādi aff.
उच्च: उच्च mfn. (-च्चः-च्चा-च्चं) High, tall. 	 m. (-च्चः) The apex of the orbit of a planet.  E. उत् upwards, चि to gather, and ड aff.
उच्चकैस्: उच्चकैस् ind. Excessively lofty, tall, loud, &c.  E. उच्च high, कैस् aff.
उच्चघन: उच्चघन n. (-नं) Laughter in the mind not expressed in the countenance.
उच्चटा: उच्चटा f. (-टा) 	 1. Pride, arrogance. 	 2. Habit, usage. 	 3. A kind of garlic. 4. A species of grass, (a cyperus.) 	 5. A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) 6. A sort of sorrel.  E. उत् and चट् to injure, अच् and टाप् affs.
उच्चण्ड: उच्चण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 	 1. Quick, expeditious. 	 2. Passionate, violent. E. उत् implying excess, चडि to be angry, and अच् aff.
उच्चतम: उच्चतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Highest.  E. उच्च and तमप् aff.
उच्चतर: उच्चतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Higher, more lofty.  E. उच्च and तरप् aff.
उच्चतरु: उच्चतरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. The cocoanut tree. 	 2. Any lofty tree.  E. उच्च and तरु a tree.
उच्चता: उच्चता f. (-ता) Height; also उच्चत्व n. (-त्वं)  E. तल् or त्व added to उच्च.
उच्चताल: उच्चताल n. (-लं) Music and dancing at feasts, drinking parties, &c.  E. उच्च high sounding, and ताल tune.
उच्चदेव: उच्चदेव m. (-वः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. उच्च high, above, and देव a deity.
उच्चदेवता: उच्चदेवता f. (-ता) Time personified, Chronos.  E. उच्च high, and देवता divi-nity.
उच्चन्द्र: उच्चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The end of the night, the last watch of the night.  E. उत् priv. and चन्द्र the moon; moonset.
उच्चभाषण: उच्चभाषण n. (-णं) Speaking loud.  E. उच्च and भाषण speaking.
उच्चय: उच्चय m. (-यः) 	 1. The knot of the string or of the cloth which fastens the lower garments round the loins tied in front. 	 2. The opposite leg of a triangle.  E. उत् up, above, त्रि to gather, अच् aff.
उच्चरण: उच्चरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Uttering, articulating. 	 2. Going up or out.  E. उत् be-fore चर् to go, ल्युट् aff.
उच्चरित: उच्चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Uttered, articulated. 	 2. Gone up or out.  E. उत् before चर् to go, क्त aff.
उच्चल: उच्चल n. (-लं) The mind, the understanding.  E. उत् above and चल what goes.
उच्चलन: उच्चलन n. (-नं) Going up or out.  E. उत् before चल् to go, ल्युट् aff.
उच्चललाटा: उच्चललाटा f. (-टा) A woman with a high or projecting forehead.  E. उच्च high, and ललाट a forehead; also उच्चललाटिका.
उच्चलित: उच्चलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone up or out. 	 2. Winnowed.  E. उत् before चल् to go, क्त aff.
उच्चाटन: उच्चाटन n. (-नं) 	 1. Eradicating as a plant. 	 2. Ruining, (as an individual.) 3. Causing a person's ruin by magical incantations.  E. उच्च up, and अटन going.
उच्चार: उच्चार m. (-रः) 	 1. Fœces, excrement. 	 2. Pronounciation, utterance.  E. उत् before चर् to go, and घञ् aff.
उच्चारण: उच्चारण n. (-णं) Articulating, enunciation.  E. उत् before चर् to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उच्चारणज्ञ: उच्चारणज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A linguist, one skilled in languages or sounds. E. उच्चारण and ज्ञ who knows.
उच्चारणस्थान: उच्चारणस्थान n. (-नं) The part of the throat, &c. whence certain sounds, as nasals, gutturals, and the like proceed.  E. उच्चारण and स्थान place.
उच्चारणार्थ: उच्चारणार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Necessary for pronounciation, a superfluous letter, &c. उच्चारण and अर्थ object.
उच्चारित: उच्चारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pronounced, uttered, articulated.  E. उत् before चर् to go, causal form, क्त aff.
उच्चार्य: उच्चार्य्य ind. Having spoken or uttered. 	 mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spoken, to be pronounced.  E. उत् before चर् to go, causal form, affix ल्यप् or यत्.
उच्चार्य्य: उच्चार्य्य ind. Having spoken or uttered. 	 mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spoken, to be pronounced.  E. उत् before चर् to go, causal form, affix ल्यप् or यत्.
उच्चार्यमाण: उच्चार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being uttered or pronounced.  E. उच्चर, causal form, शानच् aff.
उच्चार्य्यमाण: उच्चार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being uttered or pronounced.  E. उच्चर, causal form, शानच् aff.
उच्चावच: उच्चावच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 	 1. Various, multiform. 	 2. Uneven, irregular, undulating. 	 3. High and low.  E. उदक् upper, and अवाक् lower, great and small, &c.; the compound is irregular.
उच्चिकीर्षा: उच्चिकीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Desire or wish to collect.  E. उत् before चि to collect, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उच्चूल: उच्चूल m. (-लः) The flag or pennon of a banner.  E. उत् above, and चूड to be high; ल is substituted for ड.
उच्चैःश्रवस्: उच्चैःश्रवस् m. (-वाः) The horse of INDRA.  E. उच्चैस् high, and श्रवस् an ear, long-eared; it is sometimes written with a final vowel, nom. (-सः).
उच्चैस्वर: उच्चैस्वर m. (-रः) A loud sound or voice.  E. उच्चैस् and स्वर sound.
उच्चैर्घुष्ट: उच्चैर्घुष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Making a loud noise, clamour.  E. उच्चैस् high, loud, and घुष्ट sound.
उच्चैस्: उच्चैस् ind. High, loud, great, much, &c.  E. उत् much, चि to collect, डैस् Unādi aff.
उच्चैस्तम: उच्चैस्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Very high, tall or lofty. 	 2. Very loud. E. उच्चैस् and तमप् aff.
उच्चैस्तमाम्: उच्चैस्तमाम् ind. 	 1. Loudly, aloud. 	 2. On high, high.  E. आमु added to the last.
उच्चैस्तर: उच्चैस्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Loftier. 	 2. Louder.  E. उच्चैस् and तरप् aff.
उच्यमान: उच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) To be said.  E. वच् to speak, pass. v. शानच् aff.
उच्छ: उच्छ r. 1st and 6th cls. (इ) उच्छि (उञ्छतिः) 1. To glean. 	 2. To gather little by little. (ई) उच्छी (उच्छति) or usually with वि prefixed (व्युच्छति) 1. To end or terminate, to leave off. 	 2. To finish or conclude. 	 3. To pass or quit. 	 4. To bind. With प्र, to wipe off.
उच्छन्न: उच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Destroyed. 	 m. (-न्नः) Peace obtained by ceding valuable lands.  E. उत् before छद् to go, affix क्त.
उच्छलत्: उच्छलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Going or moving on or against.  E. उत्, शक to go, ल्युट् aff.
उच्छलन: उच्छलन n. (-नं) 	 1. Going upon. 	 2. Having over, or above, or against. E. उत् before शल to go, ल्युट् aff.
उच्छादन: उच्छादन n. (-नं) Cleaning with perfumes.  E. उत् before छद् to cover, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
उच्छालित: उच्छालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Waved, waved above. 	 2. Gone, went. 	 3. Shaken.  E. उत् before शल् to go, causal form, क्त aff.
उच्छास्त्रवर्तिन्: उच्छास्त्रवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Transgressing, deviating from the ritual.  E. उत् before शास्त्र scripture, वर्त्तिन् who abides.
उच्छास्त्रवर्त्तिन्: उच्छास्त्रवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Transgressing, deviating from the ritual.  E. उत् before शास्त्र scripture, वर्त्तिन् who abides.
उच्छिख: उच्छिख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 	 1. Flaming, blazing up. 	 2. Radiant. 	 3. High-crested.  E. उत् up, शिखा a flame.
उच्छिङ्घन: उच्छिङ्घन n. (-नं) Breathing through the nostrils, snuffing, snoring.  E. उत् before शिघि to smell, ल्युट् aff.
उच्छिद्य: उच्छिद्य ind. Having cut off, destroyed, killed, &c.  E. उत् before छिद् to cut, ल्यप् aff.
उच्छिन्न: उच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Cut, cut off or cut. 	 2. Destroyed, killed.  E. उद् before छिन्न cut.
उच्छिलीन्ध्र: उच्छिलीन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) A mushroom.  E. उत् and शिलीन्ध्र.
उच्छिष्ट: उच्छिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Left, rejected as food; (i. e. spit out of the mouth, or orts, crumbs, fragments, &c.) 	 2. Left, abandoned.  E. उत् up, शिष् to leave as a residue, and क्त aff.
उच्छिष्टभोजन: उच्छिष्टभोजन m. (-नः) 	 1. One who eats another's leavings. 	 2. The at-tendant upon an idol, whose food is the leavings of the deities. E. उच्छिष्ट orts, and भोजन food.
उच्छिष्टभोजिन्: उच्छिष्टभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Who eats the remains of a meal. E. उच्छिष्ट and भोजिन् who eats.
उच्छिष्टमोदन: उच्छिष्टमोदन n. (-नं) Wax.  E. उच्छिष्ट and मोदन pleasing.
उच्छिष्टान्न: उच्छिष्टान्न n. (-न्नं) Leavings, offal.  E. उच्छिष्ट and अन्न food.
उच्छीर्षक: उच्छीर्षक n. (-कं) A pillow.  E. उत् upon, and शीर्षक the head: on which rests the head.

उदरावर्त्त: उदरावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The navel.  E. उदर and आवर्त्त whirl.

A form of speech, a phrase that leaves something to be inferred ellipsis, &c.  E. उप well, much, &c. चर् to go, घञ् aff.
उपचारकरण: उपचारकरण n. (-णं) Offering presents, especially of perfumes, flowers, &c. attention, service.  E. उपचार and करण making; also उपचारकर्म्मन्, उपचारक्रिया, &c.
उपचारपर: उपचारपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Waiting upon, serving diligently.  E. उपचार ser-vice, and पर diligent.
उपचार्य: उपचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) Practice of medicine  E. उप, चर् in the causal form, and ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.
उपचार्य्य: उपचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) Practice of medicine  E. उप, चर् in the causal form, and ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.
उपचित: उपचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Collected, assembled. 	 2. Heaped. 	 3. Thriving, increasing. 	 4. Burnt. 	 5. Plastered, smeared.  E. उप much, and चित collected, from चिञ् to gather, affix क्त.
उपचित्रा: उपचित्रा f. (-त्रा) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata, Rox.) See मूषिकपर्णी.  E. उप much, चित्र variegated.
उपचूलन: उपचूलन n. (-नं) Heating, burning.  E. उप much, चूर् to burn, affix ल्युट्, र changed to ल.
उपचेय: उपचेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be collected or heaped up.  E. उप before चि to gather, ण्यत् aff.
उपच्छन्न: उपच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Secret, concealed.  E. उप and छद् to cover, क्त aff.
उपजात: उपजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Produced, engendered, aroused.  E. उप and जात born.
उपजाति: उपजाति f. (-तिः) A metre or stanza of four lines, with eleven syllables in each.
उपजाप: उपजाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Disunion, separation. 	 2. Treason, treachery.  E. उप separation, जप् to meditate, ण aff.
उपजापक: उपजापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. A mischief-maker, one who foments quar-rels. 	 2. A traitor, treacherous.  E. उप before जप् to meditate, ण्वुल् aff.
उपजिह्वा: उपजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) 	 1. A kind of insect. 	 2. The uvula or soft palate. 	 3. En-largement of the tongue.  E. उप privation or similitude, and जिह्वा the tongue.
उपजिह्विका: उपजिह्विका f. (-का) 	 1. A species of insect. 	 2. The soft palate; see the preceding.
उपजीवक: उपजीवक n. (-कं) 	 1. Act, object. 	 2. Means of subsistence.  E. उप before जीव् to live, वुन् aff.
उपजीविका: उपजीविका f. (-का) Subsistence, livelihood.  E. उप and जीविका the same.
उपजीवन: उपजीवन n. (-नं) Subsistence, means of living.  E. उप and जीवन living.
उपजीविन्: उपजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Dependent, living by or on.  E. उप and जीविन् who lives.
उपजीव्य: उपजीव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Affording a livelihood. 	 n. (-व्यं) Cause.  E. उप be-fore जीव् to live, य aff.
उपजोषम्: उपजोषम् ind. An expression indicative of joy.  E. उप much, जुष् to be kind, and अम् affix; also उपयोषम्.
उपज्ञा: उपज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Untaught knowledge.  E. उप near, with ज्ञा knowledge, from ज्ञा to know, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उपढौकन: उपढौकन n. (-नं) A respectful offering or present, a Nezer.  E. उप and ढौकन seeking.
उपतप्त: उपतप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Heated, parched. 	 2. Distressed, pained.  E. उप and तप्त heated.
उपतप्तृ: उपतप्तृ m. (-प्ता) 	 1. Morbid heat. 	 2. Any cause of heat, burning or inflam-mation.  E. उप excess, तप् to heat, तृच् aff.
उपताप: उपताप m. (-पः) 	 1. Disease. 	 2. Haste, hurry. 	 3. Heat, heatedness. 	 4. Pain. 	 5. Misfortune.  E. उप much, तप् to heat, घञ् aff.
उपतापिन्: उपतापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 	 1. Inflaming, exciting. 	 2. Heating. 	 3. Suffer-ing heat or pain. 	 4. Sick.  E. उपताप and इनि affix, or उप before तप with णिनि aff.
उपत्यका: उपत्यका f. (-का) Land near the foot of a hill or mountain.  E. उप near, त्यकन् aff.
उपदंश: उपदंश m. (-शः) 	 1. A relish, or something to promote drinking. 	 2. The venereal disease, chancre. 	 3. Biting, stinging. 	 4. A tree, the scraped root of which is used for horse-radish, (Morunga hyperanthera.) E. उप much, &c. दंश biting.
उपदर्शक: उपदर्शक m. (-कः) 	 1. A door-keeper. 	 2. A guide.  E. उप and दर्शक who shews.
उपदर्शित: उपदर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perceived, distinguished.  E. उप before दर्शित seen.
उपदा: उपदा f. (-दा) A present, an offering to a king or great man, &c. a Nezer.  E. उप, दा a gift, from दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उपदानक: उपदानक n. (-कं) A present, &c. see the preceding.  E. उप implying help, &c. दान a gift, and क affix: a gift which is for the purpose of pro-curing favour or protection.
उपदिश्य: उपदिश्य ind. Having advised or instructed.  E. उप before दिश to shew, ल्यप् aff.
उपदिष्ट: उपदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Instructed, advised. 	 2. Initiated. 	 3. Specified, particularised. 	 4. Assigned as a plea or reason. 	 n. (-ष्टं) Council, advice.  E. उप before दिश् to shew, क्त aff.
उपदेवता: उपदेवता f. (-ता) A minor divinity, as a Yaksha, Gandharba, Apsara, &c.  E. उप and देवता a divinity.
उपदेश: उपदेश m. (-शः) 	 1. Advice, information, instruction. 	 2. Plea, pretext. 	 3. Specification. 	 4. Initiation, communication of the initiatory Man-tra or formula. 	 5. (In grammar,) An elementary term.  E. उप before दिश् to shew, affix घञ्.
उपदेशक: उपदेशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Giving instruction, instructing, instructive. 	 m. (-कः) An instructor, a guide, specially a spiritual guide.  E. उप be-fore दिश् to shew, ण्वुल् aff.
उपदेशन: उपदेशन n. (-नं) Advising, instructing.  E. उप before दिश् to shew, aff. ल्युट्.
उपदेशिन्: उपदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Advising, an adviser.  E. उपदेश advice, and इनि affix.
उपदेष्टव्य: उपदेष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be advised. (fit, proper, &c.)  E. उप before दिश् to shew, तव्य affix; also उपदेश्य, उपदेशनीय.
उपदेष्टृ: उपदेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) One who points out, who orders or advises. 	 m. (-ष्टा) A Guru, a spiritual guide.  E. उप prefixed to दिश to shew, affix तृच्.
उपदेह: उपदेह m. (-हः) 	 1. Liniment, ointment. 	 2. A minor or secondary body. E. उप and दिह plaster, or देह the body.
उपदेहिका: उपदेहिका f. (-का) A kind of insect.  E. उप with, &c. देह the body, affixes कन् and टाप्; also उत्पादिका.
उपद्रव: उपद्रव m. (-वः) 	 1. Tyranny, oppression. 	 2. National distress, whether the act of the seasons or the king, famine, exaction, &c. 	 3. National commotion, rebellion. 	 4. Violence. 	 5. A supervenient disease, one brought on whilst a person labours under another.  E. उप, द्रु to go, अच् aff.
उपद्रविन्: उपद्रविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) 	 1. Tyrannical. 	 2. Violent, factious. 	 m. (-वी) 1. A tyrant, an oppressor. 	 2. A rebel.  E. उपद्रव and इनि aff.
उपद्रष्टृ: उपद्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Supervisor, inspector, overseeing, overlooking. E. उप before दृश् to see, तृच् affix, the vowel changed to र.
उपद्रुत: उपद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tyrannized over, oppressed, visited by calamities, &c.  E. उप before द्रु to go, क्त aff.
उपधर्म: उपधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 	 1. A heretic, a schismatic. 	 2. A minor or inferior duty. E. उप and धर्म्म duty.
उपधर्म्म: उपधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 	 1. A heretic, a schismatic. 	 2. A minor or inferior duty. E. उप and धर्म्म duty.
उपधा: उपधा f. (-धा) 	 1. A false pretence. 	 2. Trial or test of honesty, &c. of four kinds, of loyalty, disinterestedness, continence, and courage. 	 3. A penultimate letter.  E. उप, धा having, from धा to have, with अङ् and टाप् affs.
उपधातु: उपधातु m. (-तुः) 	 1. An inferior mineral, a semi-metal: seven are speci-fied; pyrites, sulphate of copper, talc, antimony, red orpiment, yellow orpiment, and calx of brass. 	 2. Secondary secretion, as the milk, menses, adeps, sweet, teeth, hair, and lymph.  E. उप minor, and घातु mineral, &c.
उपधान: उपधान n. (-नं) 	 1. A pillow. 	 2. Kindness, affection. 	 3. Poison. 	 4. Reli-gious observance or obligation. 	 5. Excellence, excellent quality. 	 6. Resting or placing upon.  E. उप, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.
उपधानीय: उपधानीय n. (-यं) A pillow.  E. उपधान a pillow, and छ aff.
उपधाय: उपधाय ind. Having placed or rested upon.  E. उप before धा to hold, ल्यप् affix.
उपधाशुचि: उपधाशुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Approved, tried, of approved loyalty, &c. E. उपधा and शुचि pure.
उपधि: उपधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. Fraud, circumvention. 	 2. The wheel of a carriage. 	 3. Fear, terror.  E. उप, धा to have, and कि aff.
उपधिक: उपधिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A cheat, a knave, especially one who extorts money by threats. 	 2. Fraud.  E. उपधि and कृ to make, ड affix or कन् pleonasm.
उपधूपित: उपधूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Being at the point of death. 	 2. Suffering extreme pain.  E. उप near or much, धूपित pained.
उपधृति: उपधृति f. (-तिः) A ray of light.  E. उप much, धृ to have, क्तिन् affix.
उपनत: उपनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Approached, approximate, near, (either in time or place.)  E. उप near, नम् to bow, affix क्त.
उपनय: उपनय m. (-यः) The initiation of the three first classes; investiture with a peculiar thread or cord worn over the left shoulder, and under the right: the cord of the Brahman is of cotton, Munja, or Kusa grass; of the Kshetriya, of Sana or flax; and of the Vaisya, of wool: the youths should be invested respectively, from eight to sixteen, from eleven to twenty-two, and from twelve to twenty-four years of age. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Attaining, gaining. 	 2. Bringing to E. उप over, नीञ् to obtain, अच् affix; also with घञ् affix उपनाय, and with ल्युट् affix उपनयन.
उपनयन: उपनयन n. (-नं) See the preceding. E. As before, affix ल्युट्; also with अण् added उपनायन.
उपनाह: उपनाह m. (-हः) 	 1. A plaster, an unguent applied to a wound or sore. 2. The tie of a lute, the lower part of the tail piece where the wires are fixed. 	 3. Inflammation of the ciliary glands, stye.  E. उप, नह् to bind, घञ् aff.
उपनाहन: उपनाहन n. (-नं) Unction, anointing, plastering.  E. उप before नह् to tie, ल्युट् aff.
उपनिक्षेप: उपनिक्षेप m. (-पः) A deposit, sealed or in a cover so that the contents are unknown.  E. उप and निक्षेप the same.
उपनिधान: उपनिधान n. (-नं) A deposit: see the next.  E. उप and नि before धा to have, ल्युट् affix.
उपनिधि: उपनिधि m. (-धिः) A deposit, a pledge, property put into the care of a creditor, friend, &c.  E. उप and नि before धा to have, क affix; in law this word ordinarily implies more especially a sealed or enclosed deposit, but according to some, it is any article entrusted to a friend which he may use whilst in his keeping.
उपनिषद्: उपनिषद् f. (-षद् or -षत्) 	 1. A portion of the religious writings of the Hindus; the theological part, and the Vedanta or argumentative part of the Vedas, either detached from or comprised in the princi-pal work. 	 2. Virtue, moral merit. 	 3. Truth as the principle of divine being. 	 4. A neighbouring mansion. 	 5. A lonely place.  E. उप and नि prefixed to षद् to go, affix क्विप्; in which abide the essential parts of religion, &c.
उपनिष्कर: उपनिष्कर n. (-रं) 	 1. A street. 	 2. A principal or royal road.  E. उप and नि before कृ to make, affix अप्, and स inserted.
उपनिष्क्रमण: उपनिष्क्रमण n. (-णं) 	 1. A main or royal road. 	 2. An instituted observance or Sanskara, taking a child in the fourth month of its age into the open air. 	 3. Going forth.  E. उप and नि before क्रम् to go, affix ल्युट्, and स inserted.
उपनिहित: उपनिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Deposited with, entrusted to. 	 2. Placed near to. 	 3. Offered, presented.  E. उप and नि before धा to to have, क्त aff.
उपनीत: उपनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Brought near to, approximated. 	 2. Obtained, attained. 	 3. Citing, adducing. 	 4. Presented. 	 5. Known. 	 m. (-तः) The youth invested with the characteristic string; see उपनय.  E. उप be-fore नी to obtain, affix क्त.
उपनीय: उपनीय ind. 	 1. Having brought. 	 2. Having invested.  E. उप before नी to bring, ल्यप् aff.
उपनुन्न: उपनुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Sent or dispatched. 	 2. Wafted, driven, (by the wind.)  E. उप before नुद् to send, क्त aff.
उपन्यस्त: उपन्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Pledged, deposited. 	 2. Given, communicated. 3. Brought forward, (as an example, &c.) adduced. 	 4. Placed near to, or in, or upon.  E. उप and नि before अस् to throw, affix क्त.
उपन्यास: उपन्यास m. (-सः) 	 1. A pledge, a pawn, a hostage. 	 2. An exordium or in-troduction. 	 3. A precept, a law. 	 4. Giving, imparting. 	 5. Juxta-position. 	 6. A suggestion, a hint.  E. उप and नि prefixed to अस् to throw or send, affix घञ्.
उपन्यास्य: उपन्यास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be pledged.  E. उप and न्यास्य to be adduced.
उपपति: उपपति m. (-तिः) A paramour, a gallant.  E. उप in place of, पति a husband.
उपपत्ति: उपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Birth, production. 	 2. Association, connexion. 	 3. Fit-ness, propriety. 	 4. Cessation, end. 	 5. Possessing, having. 	 6. As-certained or demonstrated conclusion. 	 7. Cause, reason. 	 8. Effect-ing, doing. 	 9. Religious abstraction. 	 10. (In arithmetic or geo-metry,) Proof, demonstration.  E. उप before पद् to go, क्तिन् aff.
उपपत्तिमत्: उपपत्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 	 1. Right, fit, reasonable, proper. 	 2. Unit-ed, associated.  E. उपपत्ति and मतुप् poss aff.
उपपद: उपपद n. (-दं) 	 1. Small, diminutive. 	 2. The subsidiary term in a com-pound word. 	 3. The first member of a compound word. 	 4. An aptote a word sometimes used as an adverb and sometimes as an inflected noun. 	 5. A secondary noun in a sentence in conjunction or apposition.  E. उप before पद a foot, or an inflected word.
उपपन्न: उपपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Manifested. 	 2. Fit, suited to the occasion, adequate. 	 3. Done, shewn, proved, effected. 	 4. Endowed with, possessed of. 	 5. Produced from or by. 	 6. Physicked, cured.  E. उप before पद् to go, क्त aff.
उपपातक: उपपातक n. (-कं) A great crime, as killing a cow, selling a daughter, atheism, &c.; it is considered as criminality in the second or third degree, and is of various kinds: see महापातक.  E. उप much, and पातक a crime.
उपपातकिन्: उपपातकिन् m. (-की) A sinner in any but the first degree.  E. उपपातक and इनि affix.
उपपादन: उपपादन n. (-नं) 	 1. Effecting, doing. 	 2. Giving, delivering, presenting. 3. Proving or establishing by argument.  E. उप before पद् to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उपपादित: उपपादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Done, effected. 	 2. Given delivered, present-ed. 	 3. Proved, accomplished.  E. उप before पद् to go, causal form, क्त aff.
उपपादुक: उपपादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Shod. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A superhuman being, a god, a demon, &c. 	 2. Hell.  E. उप before पद् to go, उकञ् aff.
उपपाप: उपपाप m. (-पः) A heinous crime, as killing a cow, &c.  E. उप excess, and पाप sin.
उपपालित: उपपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, nurtured.  E. उप and पालित protected.
उपपीडन: उपपीडन n. (-नं) 	 1. Pain, agony, torture. 	 2. Inflicting pain. 	 3. Devas-tating, laying waste.  E. उप before पीड to give pain, ल्युट् aff.
उपपीडित: उपपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Tortured, pained, distressed. 	 2. Devastated. E. उप before पीड to give pain, क्त aff.
उपपुर: उपपुर n. (-रं) A suburb.  E. उप near, पुर a city.
उपपुराण: उपपुराण n. (-णं) A Purana, one not included in the eighteen principal: a similar number is reckoned, or 1. Adi. 	 2. Nrishinha. 	 3. Vayu. 4. Sivadhermma. 	 5. Durvasa. 	 6. Nārada. 	 7. Nandikeswara. 8. Usanas. 	 9. Kapila. 	 10. Varuna. 	 11. Sāmba. 	 12. Kālikā. 	 13. Maheswara. 	 14. Padma. 	 15. Deva. 	 16. Parāsara. 	 17. Marīcha. 18. Bhaskara.  E. उप minor, पुराण a Purāna.
उपपुष्पिका: उपपुष्पिका f. (-का) Yawning, gaping.  E. उप much, पुष्प to flower, to open as a flower, वुन् aff.
उपप्रदान: उपप्रदान n. (-नं) A bribe.  E. उप for assistance, प्र before दा to give, affix ल्युट्.
उपप्लव: उपप्लव m. (-वः) 	 1. Rahu, the ascending node. 	 2. A portent or natural phænomenon so considered. 	 3. An affray, or assault, a conflict without weapons. 	 4. Eclipse. 	 5. Misfortune.  E. उप over, &c. प्लु to go, अप् aff.
उपप्लुत: उपप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Distressed, pained. 	 2. Harassed (by Rāhu, &c.) eclipsed. 	 3. Assailed, beset. 	 4. Marked by prodigies. 	 5. Wet, moistened. 	 f. (-ता) Morid sensibility of the uterus.  E. उप before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
उपभुक्त: उपभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Used, enjoyed, possessed.  E. उप before भुज् to enjoy, क्त aff.
उपभुञ्जान: उपभुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Using, enjoying.  E. उप before भुज् to enjoy, शानच् aff.

उपासन: उपासन n. (-नं) 	 1. Archery. 	 2. Service. 	 3. A seat. 	 4. Assembling. 	 5. In-juring, hurting. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. Service. 	 2. Worship, adoration.  E. उप before आस् to sit, or आङ् before अस् to throw or send, affix युच् and fem. टाप्.
उपासित: उपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Served, honoured, worshipped. 	 2. Serving, paying worship or service.  E. उप inferiority, आस् to sit or remain, affix क्त.
उपासितृ: उपासितृ m. (-ता) A worshipper.  E. उप and आङ् before आस् to sit, तृन् aff.
उपासीन: उपासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Sitting with or near to. 	 2. Occupying.  E. उप before आसीन seated.
उपास्ति: उपास्ति f. (-स्तिः) Service, especially of a deity, worship.  E. उप before आस् to sit, क्तिन् aff.
उपास्य: उपास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be worshipped or served. ind. 	 1. Having served or worshipped. 	 2. Having associated or called together. E. उप before आस् to sit, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
उपास्यमान: उपास्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being served or worshipped, receiving hom-age.  E. उप before आस् to sit, शानच् aff.
उपाहित: उपाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Joined, annexed. 	 2. Deposited, placed. 	 3. Put on, worn. 	 4. Agreed upon, made or done mutually. 	 m. (-तः) A fiery potent, a meteor, a comet.  E. उप and आङ् before धा to have or hold, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
उपाहृत: उपाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Prepared. 	 2. Taken, seized.  E. उप and आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
उपेक्षक: उपेक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining. 	 2. Patient, enduring.  E. उप before ईक्ष् to see, वुन् aff.
उपेक्षण: उपेक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Leaving, abandoning. 	 2. Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining.  E. उप and ईणक्ष seeing.
उपेक्षा: उपेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 	 1. Trick, deceit, one of the minor expedients in war. 	 2. Abandoning, leaving. 	 3. Dissent. 	 4. Negligence, neglect. 	 5. En-durance, patience. 	 6. Contempt, disdain.  E. उप before ईक्ष् to see, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उपेक्षित: उपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disregarded, disesteemed, neglected, disdained. E. उप before ईक्ष् to see, क्त aff.
उपेत: उपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Endowed with, possessed of, having, possessing. 2. Arrived at, come to, come near to. 	 3. Invested.  E. उप and इत gone.
उपेतृ: उपेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 	 1. Contriving, contriver, one who employs expedi-ents. 	 2. Approaching, going near to.  E. उप before इण् to go, तृच् aff.
उपेन्द्र: उपेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of VISHNU or KRISHNA.  E. उप after, इन्द्र INDRA: born subsequently to INDRA.
उपेन्द्रवज्रा: उपेन्द्रवज्रा f. (-ज्रा) A species of the Trishtubh metre.
उपेय: उपेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be sought, to be had recourse to. 	 2. To be gone to or approached. 	 3. To be effected by any means.  E. उप be-fore इण् to go, यत् aff.
उपेयिवस्: उपेयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वत्) 	 1. Accompanied or followed by, associated with, united. 	 2. Obtained, got.  E. उप near, इण् to go, क्वसु aff.
उपेयुस्: उपेयुस् mfn. (-यूः-यूः-युः) Arrived at, gone to.  E. उप before इण् to go, उस् aff.
उपोढ: उपोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Near, proximate. 	 2. Married. 	 3. Arrayed, ar-ranged.  E. उप before वह् to bear, aff. क्त.
उपोती: उपोती f. (-ती) A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.)  E. उप much, and उद water, deriv. irr.
उपोदिका: उपोदिका f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.)  E. उप and उद water, कन् and टाप् affs. and इ substituted for the pen. or ई being substituted उपोदीका.
उपोद्घात: उपोद्घात m. (-तः) 	 1. A beginning, a thing begun. 	 2. An introduction, a preface. 	 3. An example, an apposite argument or illustration. 4. Analysis, the ascertainment of the elements of which a thing consists.  E. उप before हन् to injure, aff. घञ्.
उपोषण: उपोषण n. (-णं) A fast, fasting.  E. उप before वस to abide, aff. ल्युट्.
उपोषित: उपोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fasted, fasting. 	 n. (-तं) Fast, fasting.  E. उप before वस् to abide, क्त aff.
उप्त: उप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Sown, (as seed.)  E. वप् to sow, affix क्त.
उप्तकृष्ट: उप्तकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ploughed after sowing.  E. उप्त and कृष्ट ploughed.
उप्ति: उप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Sowing seeds.  E. वप् to sow, क्तिन् aff.
उप्तिविद्: उप्तिविद् m. (-वित् or -विद्) An agriculturist.  E. उप्ति and विद् who knows.
उप्तिम: उप्तिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Sown, cultivated.  E. वप् to sow, क्तिन् aff. and मम् added.

उब्ज r. 6th cl. (उब्जति) To be straight: see ऊब्ज.

उभयतस्: उभयतस् ind. On both sides.  E. उभय both, and तसि aff.

उभयतोमुख: उभयतोमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking either way, two-faced.  E. उभयतस् and मुख face.
उभयत्र: उभयत्र ind. In both places, on both sides.  E. उभय and त्रल् aff.
उभयथा: उभयथा ind. In both ways.  E. उभय and थाल् aff.
उभयद्युस्: उभयद्युस् ind. Both days, the day past and to come.  E. उभय both, द्युस् aff.; or with एद्युस् aff. उभयेद्युस्.

उभयवेतन: उभयवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Serving two masters, being in the pay of both.  E. उभय and वेतन wages.
उभयसम्भव: उभयसम्भव m. (-वः) A dilemma.  E. उभय both, (conclusions,) सम्भव production.
उभयानुमत: उभयानुमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Agreed to or accepted mutually, or on both sides.  E. उभय and अनुमत assented to.
उभयार्थम्: उभयार्थम् ind. For a double object, (as for prosperity in earth and happi-ness in heaven.)  E. उभय and अर्थ an object.
उम्: उम् ind. An interjection, 1. Of anger. 	 2. Interrogation. 	 3. Promise or assent; and 4. Of cordiality or pacification.
उम: उम m. (-मः) 	 1. A city, a town. 	 2. A wharf, a landing place. 	 f. (-मा) 	 1. A name of the goddess PARVATI or DURGA. 	 2. Light, splendor. 	 3. Fame, reputation. 	 4. Turmeric. 	 5. उमागुरु: उमागुरु m. (-रुः) The mountain Himalaya.  E. उमा the goddess, and गुरु a spiritual teacher: in mythology the personified mountain is the father of UMA.
उमापति: उमापति m. (-तिः) A name of SIVA.  E. उमा and पति master; the husband of UMA.
उमावन: उमावन n. (-नं) A name of Vanapura or Devi Kota, (Devi Cote.)  E. उमा and वन a grove; the residence of UMA.
उमासुत: उमासुत m. (-तः) A name KARTIKEYA.  E. उमा and सुत a son, the son of PARVATI.
उमेश: उमेश m. (-शः) A title of SIVA.  E. उमा and ईश a lord: see उमापति.
उम्भ: उम्भ r. 6th cl. (प) (उम्भति) To fill; also उभ.
उम्य: उम्य n. (-म्यं) A field of linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.)  E. उमा flax, and यत् affix; also औमीन.
उम्बर: उम्बर m. (-रः) The upper-timber of a door-frame.  E. उद् up, above, वृ to screen, अप् aff.
उम्बी: उम्बी f. (-म्बी) The stalks of wheat or barley fried over a fire of wet grass, considered as a tonic.
उरःक्षत: उरःक्षत n. (-तं) Injury of the lungs, breaking a blood-vessel, consumption. E. उरस् and क्षत lesion.
उरःस्थल: उरःस्थल n. (-लं) The breast, the bosom.  E. उरस् the breast, and स्थल place.
उरःसूत्रिका: उरःसूत्रिका f. (-का) A pearl-necklace.  E. उरस् the breast, and सूत्र thread, टच् aff.
उरग: उरग m. (-गः) A snake.  E. उरस् the breast, and ग who goes, from गम् to go, affix ड; also उरङ्ग and उरङ्गम.
उरगस्थान: उरगस्थान n. (-नं) The infernal regions below the earth.  E. उरग and स्थान a place or country: the abode of the Nagas or serpents.
उरगारि: उरगारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. GARUDA the bird of VISHNU. 	 2. A large crane. E. उरग a snake, and अरि the enemy.
उरगाशन: उरगाशन n. (-नं) 	 1. A name of GARUDA the bird of VISHNU. 	 2. The gigantic crane.  E. उरग and अशन food; whose food is of serpents.
उरगेन्द्र: उरगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The king of snakes, SESHA or VASUKI.  E. उरग and इन्द्र chief.
उरङ्ग: उरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A snake, a serpent: see उरग, the affix being खच्; also उरङ्गम.
उरण: उरण m. (-णः) 	 1. A ram. 	 2. A cloud. 	 f. (-णी) A ewe.  E. ऋ to go, क्यु affix, leaving ण, and उ substituted for the antepenultimate.
उरणाक्ष: उरणाक्ष m. (-क्षः) Cassia, (Alata.)  E. उरण ram, अक्ष an eye: the flower being so compared: क being added, also उरणाक्षक.
उरणाख्य: उरणाख्य m. (-ख्यः) Cassia: see the preceding.  E. उरण and आख्या a name; named from the ram; also उरणाख्यक, क being added.
उरभ्र: उरभ्र m. (-भ्रः) A ram.  E. उरु much, भ्रम् to wander, ड affix, and the final of उरु dropped.

उररीकार: उररीकार m. (-रः) A promise, an agreement.  E. उररी, कार what makes.
उररीकृत: उररीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Promised, agreed. 	 2. Spread, diffused. E. उररी and कृत made.
उरश्छद: उरश्छद m. (-दः) Armour, mail.  E. उरस् the breast, and छद a covering.
उरस्: उरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Best, excellent. 	 n. (-रः) The breast, the bosom.  E. ऋ to go, Unādi affix असुन्, the pen. changed to उ; also उर a Soutra root, to go, and असुन् as before.
उरसिज: उरसिज m. (-जः) The female breast.  E. उरस् the breast, in the 7th case, ज produced.
उरसिरुह: उरसिरुह m. (-हः) The female breast.  E. उरसि on the breast, and रुह what grows.
उरसिल: उरसिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Broad-chested, having a full or broad breast. E. उरस् and इलच् aff.

उरस्तस्: उरस्तस् ind. From the breast.  E. उरस् and तसि aff.

उरस्य: उरस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) From the breast. 	 mf. (-स्यः-स्या) A legitimate son or daughter, that is, one born from a married couple of the same tribe or cast.  E. उरस् the breast, and यत् aff.
उरस्वत्: उरस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Broad-chested, full-breasted, strong. E. उरस् and मतुप् poss. aff.
उराह: उराह m. (-हः) A horse of a pale colour, with dark legs.
उरी: उरी ind. A particle, implying, (especially in composition.) 	 1. Promise, assent. 	 2. Expansion; also उररी and ऊरी.
उरीकार: उरीकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Promise. 	 2. Extension.  E. उरी, and कार what makes.
उरीकृत: उरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Promised. 	 2. Expanded, spread.  E. उरी and कृत made; also उररीकृत and ऊरीकृत.
उरु: उरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-र्व्वी-रु) 	 1. Large, great. 	 2. Much, excessive. 	 3. Long. 4. Valuable, precious.  E. ऊर्णु to cover, कु Unādi affix; ऊ is made short, and ण dropped by special rule.
उरुकाल: उरुकाल m. (-लः) A creeper, (Cucumis colocynthis.)  E. उरु and काल time, of long growth; also with कन् added उरुकालकः.
उरुगाय: उरुगाय m. (-यः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. उरग a snake, इ to go, and अच् aff.
उरुतर: उरुतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, larger.  E. उरु and तरप् aff.
उरुतम: उरुतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Greatest.  E. उरु and तमप् aff.
उरुताप: उरुताप m. (-पः) Great heat.  E. उरु much, ताप heat.
उरुत्व: उरुत्व n. (-त्वं) Magnitude, vastness.  E. उरु and त्व affix; also उरुता.
उरुमार्ग: उरुमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A long road.  E. उरु and मार्ग a road.
उरुरी: उरुरी ind. A particle, of 1. Assent. 	 2. Expansion: see उररी.

उरुहार: उरुहार m. (-रः) A valuable necklace.  E. उरु and हार a necklace.
उरोगामिन्: उरोगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 	 1. Creeping, crawling, going on the belly as a reptile.  E. उरस् and गामिन् who goes.

उरोघात: उरोघात m. (-तः) 	 1. Striking or beating the breast. 	 2. Pain in the chest. E. उरस् and घात a wound.
उरोज: उरोज m. (-जः) The female breast.  E. उरस् the breast, and ज produced.
उर्जित: उर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left.  E. वर्ज्ज to abandon, क्त affix, and the vowel substituted.
उर्ज्जित: उर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left.  E. वर्ज्ज to abandon, क्त affix, and the vowel substituted.
उर्णनाभ: उर्णनाभ m. (-भः) A spider.  E. उर्ण wool, नाभि a navel, affix ड.

उर्द्र: उर्द्र m. (-र्द्रः) An otter.  E. उर्द् to play, रन् aff.
उर्व: उर्व्व r. 1st cl. (ई,) उर्वी (उर्वति) To kill or hurt.
उर्व्व: उर्व्व r. 1st cl. (ई,) उर्वी (उर्वति) To kill or hurt.
उर्वट: उर्व्वट m. (-टः) A year.  E. उरु much, and अट् to go, अच् aff.
उर्व्वट: उर्व्वट m. (-टः) A year.  E. उरु much, and अट् to go, अच् aff.
उर्वरा: उर्व्वरा f. (-रा) 	 1. Fertile soil, yielding every kind of crop. 	 2. Land in general.  E. उरु much, ऋ to go, अप् and टाप् affs.
उर्व्वरा: उर्व्वरा f. (-रा) 	 1. Fertile soil, yielding every kind of crop. 	 2. Land in general.  E. उरु much, ऋ to go, अप् and टाप् affs.

उष्मस्वेद: उष्मस्वेद m. (-दः) A vapour bath.  E. उष्म and स्वेद sweat.
उष्मागम: उष्मागम m. (-मः) The hot season: see उष्णागम.
उस्र: उस्र m. (-स्रः) 	 1. A bull. 	 2. A ray of light. 	 f. (-स्रा) 	 1. A cow. 	 2. A plant, (Anthericum tuberosum, Rox.)  E. वस् to dwell, रक् Unādi aff.
उह: उह r. 1st cl. (इर्) उहिर् (ओहति) or (इ) उहि (उंहति) 1. To hurt or give pain. 	 2. To kill, to destroy. With वि and अप, pre. to destroy, to remove.
उहान: उहान m. (-नः) The name of a country.
